components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font:600 14px/1.6 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;background:var(--ink, #f2f3f5);color:#141619;border-color:transparent;} .ds-primary:hover {background:#d6dbe2;} .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #90bfff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled {opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference) {.ds-primary {transition:background-color 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out;}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font:600 14px/1.6 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;background:var(--surface, #17191b);color:var(--ink, #f2f3f5);border-color:var(--line, #363a3f);} .ds-secondary:hover {background:var(--raised, #202326);} .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #90bfff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary:disabled {opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference) {.ds-secondary {transition:background-color 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out;}}

components.name: Text Button
components.css: .ds-text {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font:600 14px/1.6 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;color:var(--muted, #aeb4bd);border-color:transparent;padding:8px 10px;} .ds-text:hover {background:var(--raised, #202326);color:var(--ink, #f2f3f5);} .ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #90bfff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text:disabled {opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference) {.ds-text {transition:background-color 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out;}}

components.name: Status Label
components.description: Text communicates the state alongside semantic color.

narrative.overview:
A professional developer console inspired by the user-selected Resend reference. Restrained charcoal surfaces, neutral borders and near-white primary actions support dense operational work. The visual character is direct, quiet and practical.

This contract describes the implemented dashboard and the authentication views sharing public/dashboard.css. It does not establish a new visual identity for the public landing page. Page strategy lives in .impeccable/surfaces/dashboard.md; product constraints live in PRODUCT.md.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral dark surfaces with tonal separation.
System UI typography and compact, labeled controls.
Wide record lists and restrained outline iconography.
Visible keyboard focus and status text alongside color.

rules.name: The Status Text Rule
rules.body: Color supports a status label; it never replaces the label or collapses accepted and delivered into one state.

dos: Do reuse the dashboard color roles and visible focus treatment.
Do keep record lists flexible and forms compact.
Do pair status color with explicit text and preserve the distinction between accepted and delivered.
Do retain direct page URLs, active navigation and the mobile menu disclosure.
donts: Don't apply this dashboard contract to the landing page without an explicit decision.
Don't replace labeled operational controls with icon-only actions.
Don't add decorative shadows, gradients or animated movement to the flat console surfaces.
Don't expose internal design documentation as public application content.
